verification_categories_derived_from_spe: TMDS encoder 256-input exhaustive sweep × 3 channels — verify 8 → 10 transition-minimised encoding produces canonical character per running-disparity state.
Running disparity tracking — verify DC-balance state machine over arbitrary input sequences; per-channel state independent.
Control character generation — sweep {VSYNC,HSYNC} ∈ {00,01,10,11}; verify TX0 emits 0x354/0x0AB/0x154/0x2AB respectively.
CTL[3]=0 invariant — verify TX2 control characters always have CTL[3]=0 (HDCP reserved).
DE rising/falling transitions — verify clean encoding at DE=0→1 and 1→0 boundaries; no glitches in TMDS stream.
Pixel-rate sweep f_IDCK = 25 / 50 / 100 / 150 / 165 MHz — verify PLL lock, eye open, receiver lock at every rate.
Input mode 24-bit single-edge (BSEL=1) — drive DATA[23:0]; verify pixel reconstructs correctly.
Input mode 12-bit dual-edge (BSEL=0) — drive DATA[11:0] on both edges per Tables 6-2 / 6-3; verify pixel reconstructs.
Input swing high (V_REF=DV_DD): V_IH ≥ 0.7×DV_DD, V_IL ≤ 0.3×DV_DD.
Input swing low (V_REF=0.55..0.9 V): V_IH ≥ V_REF+0.2, V_IL ≤ V_REF-0.2.
Differential clock mode (low-swing only) — verify crossover-point timing works.
Single-ended clock — verify EDGE=0 (falling) / EDGE=1 (rising) latching.
Setup/hold sweep — t_su(IDR) ≥ 1.2 ns, t_h(IDR) ≥ 1.3 ns; t_su(IDF) ≥ 1.2 ns, t_h(IDF) ≥ 1.3 ns; t_su(ID)/t_h(ID) for dual-edge.
PLL lock-time measurement — from PD=1 to TMDS valid.
Output swing V_SWING — verify 400-600 mV single-ended with R_TFADJ ≈ 510 Ω across PVT.
Output rise/fall t_r / t_f — 75-240 ps at 165 MHz (20-80%).
Intra-pair skew t_sk(D) — ≤ 50 ps at 165 MHz on TX0/TX1/TX2/TXC.
Channel-to-channel skew t_sk(CC) — ≤ 1.2 ns at 165 MHz.
Output clock jitter t_ojit — ≤ 150 ps relative to IDCK.
De-skew sweep DK[3:1] = 000..111 (8 codes) — verify t_CD = (DK-4) × 350 ps relative latching shift.
I2C register file: write/read VEN_ID (=0x014C), DEV_ID (=0x0410), REV_ID; verify CTL_1_MODE / CTL_2_MODE / CTL_3_MODE bits behave per spec.
I2C reset (ISEL pulse-low) — verify all registers return to defaults (PD=0).
I2C address strap (A[3:1] pins) — sweep 8 combinations; verify base address 0x70..0x7E selects correctly.
Power-down toggle: cycle PD via I2C — verify TMDS goes to V_OFF and re-enables after PLL re-lock.
TDIS toggle — verify TMDS muted but PLL stays locked.
VEN / HEN toggle — verify VSYNC / HSYNC forced LOW in control characters.
DE-generator mode: enable DE_CTL.DE_GEN=1; program DE_DLY/DE_CNT/DE_TOP/DE_LIN; verify internal DE matches programmed window.
H_RES / V_RES counter accuracy — drive known HSYNC/VSYNC pattern; verify counts.
HTPLG edge detection — pulse EDGE/HTPLG; verify HTPLG bit + MDI interrupt.
RSEN sense (DC-coupled) — connect/disconnect powered receiver; verify RSEN bit.
MSEN open-drain output — program MSEL[3:1]; verify external pull-up sees correct level.
DDC EDID read — host I2C controller reads 128-byte EDID from receiver at 0xA0; verify checksum.
ESD: ±4 kV HBM on DVI pins; ±2 kV HBM on other pins.
Temperature sweep: T_A = 0 / 25 / 70 °C; verify all timing.
Supply sweep: DV_DD/PV_DD/TV_DD = 3.0 / 3.3 / 3.6 V; verify functional.
Worst-case current pattern (black-and-white checkerboard) — verify I_DD ≤ 250 mA.
fields.notes: The DVI Compliance Test Specification (DDWG) and HDMI Compliance Test Specification (HDMI LLC) define the formal verification programmes for DVI/HDMI transmitters; this list captures spec-derived design-time verification categories for the TFP410 specifically. Items related to HDMI audio data islands, video preamble + guard band, HDCP cipher, and CEC bus are NOT applicable to TFP410 (out of scope).
